title: How to Build a Social Media App — Your Own Community Platform in a Weekend
summary: Build a niche community app (profiles, posts, follows, messaging) instead of paying Discord or Slack — database, auth, and hosting included.
body_markdown: Circle.so Professional costs $89/month plus a 2% transaction fee on every membership payment. Mighty Networks charges similar rates with similar platform constraints. Both give you a pre-built feature set that you cannot customize. A Blink-built community app has your exact feature set, your exact design, zero platform transaction fees, and no monthly platform cost. The tradeoff: off-the-shelf platforms include features like livestreaming and course tools out of the box; with Blink, you build exactly what you need.
